currentPhase.description: M3.4 Qualified Release Set is promoted and no next product implementation is selected. Independent Linus architecture and Steve product/learning reviews converged on STOP_AND_OBSERVE: use the promoted local/static stack on real end-to-end cases, measure operator/distribution/learner friction, and reopen only the smallest gate justified by observed bottlenecks.

currentMain.description: Current main includes promoted M3.4 Qualified Release Set, CI-WP-013 post-merge routing closeout and GOV-WP-035 canonical-state alignment. M3.4 evidence remains bound to frozen product HEAD 870d69800dcb07fcfff9f1d232dd143c8eaa6486 and independent QA R2 HEAD 9c0e20ef176ee03532543d009f22979c95d0d748.

developmentBaseline.note: No new product implementation is authorized. Run real end-to-end cases with the promoted stack and collect minimal evidence on operator toil/errors, distribution friction, learner friction and human pedagogical-overview effort. Reopen only the smallest gate supported by observed evidence.

stageDOperatingModel.policy: disjoint development, independent QA, non-repairing integration and Governor decisions at contract, candidate and promotion boundaries

authorizedWork: Use the existing promoted M3.0-M3.4 capabilities on real source/brief cases without changing product code.

Collect minimal observation evidence: operator active minutes/manual transfers/errors/recovery effort; release-to-learner steps/time; learner start/completion/transfer/reconfirmation friction; human sequence-overview effort.

Repository maintenance and regression fixes may proceed only under a new bounded authority that preserves promoted learner runtime, factory contracts, qualified release-set integrity and reviewer independence.
heldWork: All post-M3.4 product implementation remains HOLD until real-use observation identifies a dominant bottleneck. Distribution, human overview #272 and factory/operator automation are trigger-based candidates, not selected work.
Remote publishing, signing/authentication, registry/catalog, asset/media contracts and provider/model orchestration remain HOLD without separate evidence-backed authority.
Remote publishing, signing/authentication and any asset/media contract remain HOLD and require separate bounded design/authority.
Generic Source-to-Draft, PDF/OCR/document normalization and intermediate draft schemas remain unneeded by current evidence and require a new evidence-backed decision if proposed.
Human graphical/contextual author-review debt #272 remains deferred and non-blocking until human review becomes a first-class workflow.
Gate 3 repository-write capability remains HOLD unless separately authorized.
Gate 4 parallel runtime remains HOLD unless separately authorized.
M4 Learn-it Everywhere, backend, accounts, cloud synchronization, remote catalog, commerce, tenancy and marketplace remain HOLD.
Teacher, cohort and institutional features remain HOLD before explicit later-milestone authority.
prohibitedWork: runtime LLM, remote AI API, embedded secret or network-required learning behavior without explicit future authority
direct write to main outside the repository's enforced governed pull-request process
silent product repair by an integration or QA lane in a product-owner file
destructive migration or reuse of protected RC718 storage
claiming certification, durable mastery or retention beyond observed evidence
publishing an artifact different from the exact artifact tested and promoted
embedding M3 authoring or LLM assistance code into the learner runtime artifact

activeRisks.statement: Human review of AI-authored kits lacks a sequence-level graphical/contextual overview; tracked as non-blocking debt #272.
activeRisks.closureGate: Close or supersede issue #272 only after a separately authorized human-review workflow provides sequence-level context and passes its own evidence gate.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: Keep this governance observation gate active while real end-to-end cases are run. Re-review when observed evidence shows a dominant distribution, human-review/context, operator-orchestration or learner bottleneck; otherwise continue STOP_AND_OBSERVE without opening product implementation.
